name: Xylitol
what_is: A five-carbon polyol, or sugar alcohol, consisting mainly of D-xylitol and used as a bulk sweetener and humectant in sugar-reduced foods.
why_botia: BOTIA flags E967 because it is a bulk polyol, not just an intense sweetener. EU rules require a laxative-effect warning above 10% added polyols. WHO's 2023 recommendation on non-sugar sweeteners explicitly excludes polyols.
can_1: Identify E967 or Xylitol on scanned labels.
can_2: Provide safety information regarding polyol consumption and laxative effects.
cannot_1: Verify if raw xylitol contains unlisted polyhydric alcohols above 1%.
cannot_2: Identify the exact plant raw material source.
title: Xylitol
description: A low-calorie polyol sugar alcohol obtained by catalytic hydrogenation of xylose.
